mapper.insert: insert into category (merchant_id, business_type, name, sort, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{businessType}, #{name}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: delete from category where id = #{id} and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.select: select * from category where id = #{id} and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
select * from category where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 1 order by sort asc, id asc
